verdict.line: You lose if you let the fight run long or Leap of Faith before he does; you win by forcing a fast E-into-burst trade and disengaging before his passive triggers.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by fight duration, not damage: Illaoi wins fast, discrete trades but Mordekaiser's W (Indestructible) shield-into-heal and his Darkness Rise passive make him stronger the longer a fight runs. The measured 47% win rate over 1000 games and even lane grade reflect that — Illaoi has to manufacture short trades on her terms instead of slugging it out.

theirWindow.when: You cast your R before his R is used
theirWindow.what: He will immediately Realm of Death you, and since your R (Leap of Faith) tentacles spawn on your side of the map, they're left outside the Death Realm — you fight him 1v1 with zero tentacle damage or Illaoi healing. This is an auto-loss, so never commit R first.

yourWindow.when: His R is already on cooldown (120-90s at ranks 1-3, 90s at rank 5)
yourWindow.what: All-in freely: land E (Test of Spirit, 16-12s cooldown) to force the spirit test, then W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) onto him so nearby Tentacles swing at the target too, and finish with Q. Without his R to flip the fight, your burst plus tentacle procs wins the exchange.

start.why: The measured best start (48.8% win rate, 54.8% pick) — sustain and damage to keep trading through his Q poke without losing the lane-sustain war early.

boots.why: Highest win rate boots (49% over 858 games) and correct into a fully magic damage kit — Obliterate, Death's Grasp, and Realm of Death are all magic.

core.why: Part of the top-performing build path (59.6% win rate, 57 games) — armor shred lets your tentacle procs and autos punish him faster in the short trade window you're forcing.
Second in the same build path — the attack speed and slow after casting help you land E and land tentacle hits before he can W-shield the damage away.
Closes out the highest win-rate core (59.6%) — the shield and tenacity keep you alive through his E (Death's Grasp) pull and follow-up burst.

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp rewards a single clean engage with immediate bonus damage, max health, and healing — exactly the short, decisive trade this matchup calls for, instead of Conqueror's stacking-over-time reward that plays into the prolonged fights Morde wins.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite has the highest measured win rate in this matchup (50.7%) and the grievous wounds directly cuts into his W (Indestructible) heal-back, denying the exact sustain mechanic that lets him win long fights.

playing.title: Never R before his R
playing.detail: If you commit Leap of Faith first, he Realm of Deaths you into a fight where all your tentacles are left behind — an unwinnable 1v1. Wait him out or bait his R with a fake engage.

playing.title: Force short trades, then leave
playing.detail: Open with E (Test of Spirit) into W (Harsh Lesson) and Q, then disengage. Don't stand and keep swinging — every extra second in the fight is a second his Darkness Rise passive and W shield are working against you.

playing.title: Punish his Q cooldown early
playing.detail: At rank 1, Obliterate is on an 8-second cooldown versus your Q's 10 seconds — but his poke is single-cast, so trade in right after he uses it on the wave, before he can reset with another cast.

playing.title: Use E to farm and pressure safely
playing.detail: Test of Spirit has 900 range versus his Death's Grasp's 700 — you can rip his spirit and start the vessel/tentacle clock from outside his pull range.

playing.title: Watch for the Vessel snowball
playing.detail: If your E kills him or he runs too far from the spirit, he becomes a Vessel spawning Tentacles — call your jungler in immediately, this is your best window to end the lane outright.

playing.title: Respect Indestructible before all-in
playing.detail: His W has no meaningful cooldown gate (12-8s) and unlimited range, so assume he can always shield and later consume it to heal — don't chase a low-health Morde expecting the kill without ignite or a burst item online.

playing.title: Play for late-lane sidewaves, not extended duels
playing.detail: By levels 14-18 his split-push and sustain outscale a straight fight — use your Vessel snowball and roams instead of forcing a long 1v1 top.

brief.patchCaveat: Build path, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the trade-timing and R-sequencing reasoning is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Mordekaiser has the upper hand in prolonged fights due to his (W) and (P) even when your [E] lands successfully. Mordekaiser will always win if he uses his (R) after you use [R], as all of your tentacles will be outside the Death Realm. Never use your [R] before (R), and use your [E] to harass him without being hit by (E).
